answer: Meter standing to a non-transferable bond that thaws like a glacier — a sliver released each epoch, and only when several already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign your audited work. A fleet forked from one root just mirrors itself, so its co-signs fold into a single cluster and the bond never melts; its fake heads drift and scatter like a wind-blown dune. Honest pays one slow bond; a farm must fund a distinct anchor per clone, cost rising linearly per head.
